text:
morgan_az: Customer asked for a concise evidence package tying KMS key use to tenant IDs + audit log export. They want proof of access for a 30-day window and the mapping between service account and tenant.
lee_ir: ok do we have a canonical query for the audit logs that includes key_id, principal, request_id, and tenant_id?
sandra_devops: we do for hosted KMS: query in cloud-logs -> filter: resource.type=kms_key AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail AND labels.tenant_id
morgan_az: customer explicitly asked for immutable timestamps and a hash-of-archive for chain-of-custody. can we generate a SHA256 of the export artefact and provide a signed statement?
lee_ir: yes. pattern: 1) export logs to gz, 2) compute sha256, 3) sign with sec@redwood gpg key (we already have one for evidence). sample commands: 
```
# export
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="kms_key" AND labels.tenant_id="TENANT-123"' --limit=100000 --format=json > tenant123-kms-logs.json
gzip tenant123-kms-logs.json
sha256sum tenant123-kms-logs.json.gz > tenant123-kms-logs.sha256
gpg --default-key sec@redwood --output tenant123-kms-logs.sig --armor --sign tenant123-kms-logs.sha256
```
lee_ir: for AWS CMK customers the fields differ but same flow: CloudTrail -> lookupEvents with ResourceName=arn::key/TENANT_KEY -> export -> hash -> sign.
morgan_az: perfect. also need to include a small playbook entry that explains why tenant_id appears in logs (we inject tenant_id as label at request time) and how to verify it against our access-control mapping.
lee_ir: short doc snippet: "tenant_id label is populated by the request router before KMS call; mapping stored in tenant_metadata table (read-only export available)."
sandra_devops: important note: PII redaction — customer wants raw principalEmail. legal says we can share it if it's customer tenant data, otherwise must redact. flagging legal on this.
oncall_tess: @sandra_devops oncall - can you also snapshot the KMS audit sink to our secure bucket and pin retention to 90 days? customer needs 30 but we keep 90 as internal policy. I'll handle the bucket ACLs.
sandra_devops: doing now. running the export and will paste head of the gz here (sanitized).
ir-bot: INCIDENT Playbook reminder: when exporting audit logs for customer evidence, create a tracking ticket in SLE-EVIDENCE-<id> and attach sha256 + signer identity.
morgan_az: also the SQ asked whether we can prove that a given model serving request did NOT access plaintext customer data. we should add guidance: show KV-cache filenames, prefix cache hits, and any denylist hits. short example query to show no access: 
```
# find any calls that referenced customer PII labels
gcloud logging read 'jsonPayload.request.labels.pii=true AND labels.tenant_id="TENANT-123"' --limit=1
```
lee_ir: small vuln triage aside: backlog CVE-2025-xxxx affects one older KMS client lib; we patched in runtime-2.1.0. need to include the patch evidence (release note + CHANGES.md) in packet.
morgan_az: add that to evidence list. also include our RBAC change request that locked service accounts to minimal kms:Encrypt / kms:Decrypt and removed iam:ServiceAccountTokenCreator for the tenant role.
sandra_devops: I made the RBAC change yesterday, PR #4589. here's the short audit entry showing the bind change: 
```
# condensed log
2026-08-12T09:12:33Z iam.bindings.update principal: serviceAccount:svc-tenant-123@redwood prod-policy:roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter -> added
2026-08-12T09:12:34Z iam.bindings.remove principal: serviceAccount:svc-tenant-123@redwood roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator -> removed
```
oncall_tess: we'll need a reviewer to ACK the export before shipping. @lee_ir you can be the security reviewer?
lee_ir: ack I will review the signed archive and confirm checksums. will also validate that exported logs cover the customer requested window.
morgan_az: can someone run a quick sample export and post the sha256 and first 5 lines (redacted) so I can draft the SQ response?
sandra_devops: uploading now to secure-bucket://evidence/tenant123/6901234567/tenant123-kms-logs.json.gz, sha256: 3b6f1c9a2a9b4f5e6d8c9a6e7f2b1a0c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9
sandra_devops: head (redacted):
```
{"timestamp":"2026-07-25T12:01:02Z","key_id":"projects/..../keys/tenant-key-123","principal":"serviceAccount:svc-tenant-123@redwood","tenant_id":"TENANT-123","action":"Encrypt","request_id":"req-abc-123"}
{"timestamp":"2026-07-25T12:01:03Z","key_id":"projects/..../keys/tenant-key-123","principal":"serviceAccount:svc-tenant-123@redwood","tenant_id":"TENANT-123","action":"Decrypt","request_id":"req-def-456"}
```
morgan_az: good. i'll draft the packet: items = [1) export gz + sig + sha256, 2) RBAC change diff + PR link, 3) patch evidence for CVE fix, 4) short explanation of tenant_id injection flow, 5) oncall handoff notes + ticket id].
lee_ir: small QA: include our log retention policy doc link: https://internal.redwood/docs/security/log-retention and mention SIEM ingest (we forward to splunk/Datadog with a 1h delay for ETL).
oncall_tess: i've created ticket SLE-EVIDENCE-7812 and pinned me as approver. once @lee_ir ACKs i'll mark ready-to-share and legal will sign off on principalEmail disclosure.
morgan_az: thanks all. @sandra_devops please leave the signed artifacts in the secure bucket and post the link in the ticket. i'll finalize the SQ response template afterwards. :thumbsup:
lee_ir: thanks — will review by EOD.
sandra_devops: done, artifacts in bucket and ticket updated. closing thread after lee ACK.
lee_ir: ACK. verified checksums and window coverage. closing. :white_check_mark:
